en.headline: Justice Department seeks review of Queen Mary lift sentence
en.dek: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said a review has been filed after a registered engineer was given community service.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said the Department of Justice has applied to review the sentence imposed on a registered engineer convicted over documents linked to lifts at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical building.
The department told media it had been informed that the application was made under section 104 of the Magistrates Ordinance. It said it would not comment further while the proceedings continued.

Reports of the case said the engineer was convicted of submitting false or misleading documents and was sentenced to 160 hours of community service. The department said it had also revoked the person's registration as a lift and escalator engineer, with the cancellation taking effect on Thursday, citing the conviction and the nature of the offences.
Of 28 lifts in the new building, 24 had been reported as faulty after the building opened in stages from last November. The Development Bureau has said it is reviewing reports on the lifts.

zh.headline: 律政司就瑪麗醫院升降機案刑罰提出覆核
zh.dek: 機電工程署表示，涉案註冊工程師被判社會服務令後，律政司已根據《裁判官條例》提出覆核，其升降機及自動梯註冊資格亦已撤銷。
body: 機電工程署表示，律政司已就瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機相關文件案的刑罰提出覆核。署方回覆查詢時指，申請是根據《裁判官條例》第104條提出，司法程序仍在進行，不便再作評論。
報道指，涉案註冊工程師因提交虛假或具誤導性文件被裁定兩項傳票罪名成立，判處一百六十小時社會服務令。機電署表示，基於定罪及罪行涉及專業操守，已一併撤銷其升降機及自動梯註冊資格，撤銷周四生效。
新大樓自去年十一月起分階段啟用，二十八部升降機中有二十四部曾被揭出現問題。發展局早前表示，正審視相關報告。
